title: A number that matches a Part Library entry only after removing spaces or punctuation is not linked
custom_preconds:
• A Part Library entry such as MP-T-S-5.0G that is not stocked at this location.
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. New Inventory Part: Description "QA near match", Part Number "MP T S 5.0G" (spaces instead of hyphens), Category, Cost, Save.
  2. Open Parts > Part Library and search both numbers.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • The part saves with no Part Library toast; the row shows the typed number and description.

Step 2:

  • Two separate entries: MP-T-S-5.0G (unchanged description) and MP T S 5.0G ("QA near match").
